title: Identify members who (1) attended a social event at '900 E. Washington St.'
question: Identify members who (1) attended a social event at '900 E. Washington St.', and (2) have incurred at least one expense. For these members, return their full names and colleges. Use subqueries to separately verify attendance and expense history without chaining more than three tables in any single FROM clause.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m."XCL_035",
    m."XCL_036",
    mj."XCL_033"
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN major AS mj
    ON mj."XCL_030" = m."XCL_042"
WHERE m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM attendance AS a
    INNER JOIN event AS e
        ON e."XCL_010" = a."XCL_001"
    WHERE e."XCL_013" = 'Social'
      AND e."XCL_015" = '900 E. Washington St.'
)
AND m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT ex."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS ex
)
